an5.154:1.1: pañcime bhikkhave dhammā saddhammassa sammosāya antaradhānāya saṃvattanti
an5.154:1.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhū na sakkaccaṃ dhammaṃ suṇanti na sakkaccaṃ dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇanti na sakkaccaṃ dhammaṃ dhārenti na sakkaccaṃ dhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthaṃ upaparikkhanti na sakkaccaṃ atthamaññāya dhammamaññāya dhammānudhammaṃ paṭipajjanti
an5.154:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave pañca dhammā saddhammassa sammosāya antaradhānāya saṃvattanti.
an5.154:2.1: pañcime bhikkhave dhammā saddhammassa ṭhitiyā asammosāya anantaradhānāya saṃvattanti
an5.154:2.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhū sakkaccaṃ dhammaṃ suṇanti sakkaccaṃ dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇanti sakkaccaṃ dhammaṃ dhārenti sakkaccaṃ dhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthaṃ upaparikkhanti sakkaccaṃ atthamaññāya dhammamaññāya dhammānudhammaṃ paṭipajjanti
an5.154:2.4: ime kho bhikkhave pañca dhammā saddhammassa ṭhitiyā asammosāya anantaradhānāya saṃvattantīti.
